unitTitle: B1 · B1 capstone: communicate independently across familiar situations
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B1 · Unit 12: B1 · B1 capstone: communicate independently across familiar situations

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: An unfamiliar service change
steps.body: A resident asks a representative about a fictional change and summarizes the answer.

examples.fr: J'ai lu que le centre modifierait ses heures.
examples.en: Awa: I read that the centre might change its hours.

examples.fr: Un essai est envisagé, mais aucune date n'a été confirmée.
examples.en: Agent: A trial is being considered, but no date has been confirmed.

examples.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, le projet est encore à l'étude.
examples.en: Awa: If I understood correctly, the plan is still under review.

examples.fr: Exactement. Nous publierons une mise à jour après la consultation.
examples.en: Agent: Exactly. We will publish an update after the consultation.

examples.fr: Merci. Pourriez-vous me dire où cette mise à jour sera affichée ?
examples.en: Awa: Thank you. Could you tell me where that update will be posted?

steps.title: A short opinion with a limit
steps.body: Two classmates discuss access to a fictional evening activity.

examples.fr: À mon avis, une option en ligne aiderait les personnes qui habitent loin.
examples.en: Sam: In my view, an online option would help people who live far away.

examples.fr: C'est possible, mais la connexion n'est pas stable pour tout le monde.
examples.en: Lina: That's possible, but the connection is not stable for everyone.

examples.fr: Tu as raison. Il faudrait garder une autre façon de participer.
examples.en: Sam: You're right. Another way to participate should remain available.

examples.fr: Un essai permettrait de voir quelles options sont utilisées.
examples.en: Lina: A trial would show which options are used.

examples.fr: Oui, puis le groupe pourrait demander des commentaires.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, then the group could ask for feedback.
